PROFESSIONAL ACCOUNTING, QUICKBOOKS IMPLEMENTATION, AND RELATED
FINANCIAL SERVICES
The Consultant shall assist the CRA with with establishing and maintaining
accounting operations, including:
• Establishing and configuring QuickBooks, including the chart of accounts,
beginning balances, bank accounts, projects, revenues, expenditures, and
financial reporting structure.
• Providing general accounting assistance, including general ledger review,
journal entries, account reconciliations, accounts payable/receivable
assistance, payroll, bank reconciliation and financial transaction review.
• Assisting with monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting and
budget-to-actual reporting.
• Assisting with fiscal year-end closing, audit schedules, adjusting entries,
reconciliations, and auditor requests.
• Reviewing accounting procedures and recommending appropriate internal
controls and segregation of duties.
• Providing QuickBooks training and technical assistance to designated CRA
and City staff.
• Providing professional accounting and financial advisory services on an as-
needed basis.
